normalization: Remove IDs/source Discipline labels/tags/names/descriptions and all numeric tuning except explicit selection count. Replace element/status identities/defense family/scaling source with generic placeholders. Preserve operation sequence, target topology, resource kinds, activation, timing, Requirement tree shapes and explicit recipient decisions.
meaning: No exact cosmetic/scalar-stripped collision is sufficient evidence of fun or balance. The independent gate must assess each authored four-Skill kit, combination rationale, actual turn choice, payoff window and counter.

concreteDecisions.why: Frontline commitment creates wounds that can be managed with triage while preserving an attack turn; recovery denial stops the opponent mirroring the sustain.
concreteDecisions.decision: Power12 and confirmed-hit5% self recovery cost50AP/5MP; sustain requires taking the frontline risk.
concreteDecisions.counter: Deny adjacency or apply Healing Down; a miss denies recovery while a connected fully Barrier-absorbed hit still qualifies.

concreteDecisions.why: Mana preparation competes with spending on a chosen precision lane; Mark improves that lane while the reserve modifier rewards retaining resources.
concreteDecisions.decision: Pay10AP/3MP for112% selected-command damage; reserves and lane compete with Aetherist spending.
concreteDecisions.counter: Drain mana or deny the firing lane before commitment.

concreteDecisions.why: A caster-healer can spend a nondamaging turn denying hostile mana while recovering Self, choosing disruption over either class stable damage or direct friendly triage.
concreteDecisions.decision: Drain4MP and independently recover6%HP for40AP/5MP; no transfer equality is implied.
concreteDecisions.counter: Low-mana opponents or Healing Down reduce value; the action supplies no damage.

concreteDecisions.why: Mana Shield produces actual protection at a reserve cost. The pair can cash its Guarded component into immediate mana and Shadehand concealment, giving up mitigation while retaining only finite Barrier. Quick Hands instead copies enemy Buffs and spendsMP without resource recovery; Smoke Vial buys concealment without sacrificing protection. All four kit choices remain distinct.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP sacrifices owner Guarded, restores4MP immediately and grants Covert1 while missingMP. Existing Barrier is unchanged; no enemy donor or copy is used.
concreteDecisions.counter: No Guarded or fullMP rejects without payment. Reapplying Guarded requires a separate real action; Sensory can answer Covert and area pressure still threatens the now unGuarded actor.

concreteDecisions.why: A frontline kit gains one included-cost approach into Mystic pressure, choosing a different defense family rather than stacking a second Physical damage bonus.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP includes Move1 and Mystic Pierce12; future equipment Armor bypass30% grants no current Defense bypass.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root the advance or use Mystic Defense; no equipment Armor means no bypass benefit.

concreteDecisions.why: A ranged support chooses whether a desperate friendly rescue is worth an explicit Vulnerable window, contrasting safe prevention with risky fast triage.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP gives9%HP and deliberately applies Vulnerable10% to that friendly recipient: a visible rescue with a vulnerability cost.
concreteDecisions.counter: Healing Down and enemy accuracy exploitation punish Vulnerable; above40% rescue is illegal.

concreteDecisions.why: Concealment knowledge and shooting lanes combine in a same-recipient Sensory-first strike, exposing a defended route rather than granting generic stealth damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: Sensory first removes eligible concealment and Reveals1, then Power8 pressures the same recipient.
concreteDecisions.counter: Break sight or avoid Covert investment; guaranteed miss must not purge/reveal.

concreteDecisions.why: A ranged fighter can claim a defended tile with an included-cost advance, giving up shot damage to establish the next firing or peeling position.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP includes Move2 and Guarded10%1, sacrificing command damage for access.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, occupancy, remaining Movement or changed elevation deny the route.

concreteDecisions.why: Eligible afflictions become a deliberate offensive copy window before a separate Self Cleanse, so relief and pressure share one chosen recipient.
concreteDecisions.decision: Copy Debuffs first, then explicitly full-Cleanse Self for40AP/6MP; donor changes only because of the separate Cleanse.
concreteDecisions.counter: No eligible copied lineage, range denial and statuses outside the Cleanse list limit the result.

concreteDecisions.why: Concealment buys access to a protection-removal and peel command instead of amplifying a sword strike; losing Covert removes that access window.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/4MP explicitly Dispels the supported positive list then Pushes1; it spends concealment setup on protection/formation control, with no damage packet.
concreteDecisions.counter: Reveal removes the prerequisite; Root/occupancy limits Push and an unbuffed target reduces Dispel value.

concreteDecisions.why: Retained mana funds close-range Mystic disruption while fist tools control access; the build trades caster safety for resource denial at contact.
concreteDecisions.decision: Mystic Power10 and MP Drain5 cost45AP/5MP; hand-range disruption replaces a ranged burst.
concreteDecisions.counter: Kite the melee caster or fight without mana.

concreteDecisions.why: The close-range half creates a two-tile separation that the ranged half can exploit next, making escape lanes and blocked Push routes decisive.
concreteDecisions.decision: Power9 plus Push2 buys a future firing lane for45AP/4MP.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, blocked tiles or remaining displacement legality limit the push.

concreteDecisions.why: A paid fist attack can buy a small finite Self recovery, allowing pressure under attrition while dedicated healer commands remain the larger recovery decision.
concreteDecisions.decision: Once per owner turn after that qualifying owner attack, pay4MP for4%maximumHP recovery. FullHP does not activate, spend mana or consume the owner-turn usage.
concreteDecisions.counter: Starve MP, apply Healing Down or deny attacks; recovery cannot trigger another attack.

concreteDecisions.why: Feint prepares vulnerability and fist displacement changes the next approach angle; the Resonance spends damage for a short peeled opening rather than a hidden crit bonus.
concreteDecisions.decision: Power8, short Vulnerable12% and Push1 expose a fresh flank at50AP/5MP.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root/occupancy blocks displacement; face the new approach or Cleanse.

concreteDecisions.why: Guard preparation authorizes a nondamaging corridor Push, letting a disciplined frontline choose formation movement over spending the same turn on another hit.
concreteDecisions.decision: 30AP/3MP pushes legal enemies1 along Line2 without damage, sacrificing pressure to move the engagement.
concreteDecisions.counter: Dispel Guarded, step off the line, Root or obstruct traversed tiles.

concreteDecisions.why: Source-relative attention and frontline peel combine into contact pressure, so the build chooses which enemy to answer instead of receiving global tank damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: Power11 and Taunted1 source-relative pressure cost45AP/4MP.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Taunt or use legal positioning/control rather than assuming forced attack behavior.

concreteDecisions.why: A low-HP recipient can receive a distinct shield-plus-recovery shelter; protection and triage compete with the build offensive or stance turns.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/6MP gives flat20Barrier and5%HP; Self is a legal explicit choice to protect a teammate.
concreteDecisions.counter: Focus through Barrier, Healing Down or forced separation counters the shelter.

concreteDecisions.why: Mana recovery can be taken under a real Fortified tradeoff, buying a resource turn at the cost of the stance constraints and lost ranged pressure.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP gives Fortified1 and4MP, trading mobility/tempo under the actual stance profile.
concreteDecisions.counter: Exploit Fortified drawback or pressure the small resource recovery.

concreteDecisions.why: The owner signals a long-range quarry while protecting Self, choosing information and a defensive firing posture rather than another damaging shot.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/4MP applies current Mark15% and Guarded10%1 to Self; it deals no damage.
concreteDecisions.counter: Close under minimum range, break sight or remove Mark.

concreteDecisions.why: Flat prevention makes a short concealed departure survivable, while the defender must choose the exact friendly recipient instead of automatically hiding the whole line.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP gives friendly-recipient Covert1 and flat15Barrier; Self is also a legal escape choice.
concreteDecisions.counter: Sensory/Reveal, legal area pressure or denial of range counters concealment.

concreteDecisions.why: Fortified preparation enables a planted separation hit whose explicit Self Root commits the owner to the reached space after driving the enemy away.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/4MP Power12 and Push2 commit the actor to Rooted1 afterward; the rooted stance pays for stronger separation.
concreteDecisions.counter: Deny adjacency or block the Push, then exploit the actor remaining planted; cleanse Fortified before cast denies setup.

concreteDecisions.why: The bruiser pays HP for an included-cost breach rather than relying on free movement, forcing the frontline to decide when access is worth exposing remaining HP.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/15HP includes Move1 and Physical Power15; safety is the access cost.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, block path or punish low HP; HP payment emits no damage event.

concreteDecisions.why: A wounded attacker can copy eligible suffering while recovering, but retains donor afflictions; triage and Reckless pressure create a deliberate affliction-management choice.
concreteDecisions.decision: Copy Debuffs first, then recover7%HP for45AP/6MP; donor afflictions remain.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse own recipient afterward or prevent legal copying; no donor cleanse is implied.

concreteDecisions.why: HP spending can approach the danger threshold while Channel preserves mana, creating a maintained risk state that directly competes with both healing and expensive releases.
concreteDecisions.decision: 110% maintained owner outgoing damage rewards a dangerous dual resource state at the Resonance slot cost.
concreteDecisions.counter: Pressure low HP or drain mana; no ongoing recovery or trigger loop exists.

concreteDecisions.why: Mark establishes a ranged quarry for a bleeding hit, letting attrition begin at distance while the Ravager half still offers a close pressure or vulnerability turn.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP Power10 seeds20% Bleed only after a real Mark setup and actual HP loss.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Mark before cast, close range or Barrier the seed hit.

concreteDecisions.why: HP expenditure and Reckless make positional concealment a dangerous offensive commitment; facing the attacker or revealing its approach undermines the planned Blindside.
concreteDecisions.decision: 55AP/15HP gives Reckless1, positional Blindside1 and Power14; the drawback is explicit.
concreteDecisions.counter: Face the attacker or exploit Reckless after the commitment.

concreteDecisions.why: Low HP creates a real emergency separation decision, allowing the fist half to change spacing while the Ravager half must decide whether to retreat or keep risking a finish.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/4MP Power12 plus Push2 creates an escape opportunity with real low-HP risk.
concreteDecisions.counter: Finish the wounded actor, Root the recipient or block the route.

concreteDecisions.why: Overlapping opposed stances can fund a planted recovery turn, forcing the bruiser to weigh survival against staying rooted rather than receiving passive extra damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: 55AP/6MP recovers16% maximumHP and explicitly Roots Self1. Both actual stance tradeoffs remain; neither stance is consumed or refreshed.
concreteDecisions.counter: Burst the wounded owner, remove a prerequisite before cast, apply Healing Down or exploit the planted tile after recovery.

concreteDecisions.why: A short actual advance and a legal Push turn access into formation control, linking remaining Movement to the front line rather than adding range from a description.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/4MP includes approach, Power10 and Push1 for a positional front-line exchange.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root either route or obstruct the destination; the actor cannot exceed remaining Movement.

concreteDecisions.why: A wounded duelist can buy a one-step recovery exit, choosing a reached tile and healing window instead of spending both command and resources on another attack.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP includes Move1 and7%HP recovery; no offensive packet or walking surcharge.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, occupancy and Healing Down challenge the exit.

concreteDecisions.why: The two-command shared cooldown makes HP-paid future mana compete with a moving Mystic release; reserve preparation and immediate access cannot both be cashed out at once.
concreteDecisions.decision: Gather pays30AP/10HP for Guarded10%1 now and5MP next round. Alternative Release pays50AP/8MP for Move1 plus Mystic Power14. Both commands share one three-owner-turn cooldown.
concreteDecisions.counter: Pressure the HP-paying preparation or block Release route/remaining Movement; using either command closes the other until the shared cooldown expires.

concreteDecisions.why: The duelist half establishes a new sightline before Mark is applied, so the archer half benefits from actual reached-origin access rather than automatic target selection.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/4MP advances up to two tiles and applies Mark10%1 without attack damage.
concreteDecisions.counter: Block route, Root the actor or deny reached-origin sight.

concreteDecisions.why: A positional strike can leave a brief Invisible window, making the owner decide whether a side/rear commitment is worth exposure to Reveal and legal area pressure.
concreteDecisions.decision: 55AP/6MP Power12 uses positional Blindside and leaves a one-turn Invisible window.
concreteDecisions.counter: Face the attacker; Sensory/Reveal and legal area threats challenge Invisible.

concreteDecisions.why: Airborne opens an elevated two-tile attack line with real displacement, linking fist preparation to formation and elevation decisions rather than a generic aerial damage buff.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/4MP Physical Power10 Line2 and Push1 pressure a narrow formation; the action uses Target Elevation3 while Airborne remains a prerequisite.
concreteDecisions.counter: Remove/outlast Airborne, step off the line or block displacement; no free Movement is granted.

concreteDecisions.why: The owner can split a friendly guard window and Self Airborne preparation, choosing who needs protection while preserving a later high-route or melee decision.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP protects that friendly recipient with Guarded12%1 and grants Self Airborne1.
concreteDecisions.counter: Separate allies, Dispel or Root the actor; the support action does no damage.

concreteDecisions.why: Safety-funded access can seed Bleed at a reached melee origin, making the player budget HP and remaining Movement instead of simply selecting the largest unconditional hit.
concreteDecisions.decision: 55AP/15HP combines bounded access with Power13 and actual15% Bleed.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, block the reached origin or Barrier the seed damage.

concreteDecisions.why: Mark makes a driven quarry eligible for a short route lock, so frontline Push and hunting setup cooperate to hold a selected engagement rather than granting all attacks extra damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP Power11 and Push1; a preexisting Mark also permits Rooted1, without consuming Mark.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Mark before cast or obstruct displacement; control is finite.

concreteDecisions.why: Trail relief separates immediate affliction removal from next-round recovery, supporting a prepared pursuit or companion turn while exposing a real focus-fire interval.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP gives full Cleanse now and one next-round7%HP application.
concreteDecisions.counter: Focus before recovery or apply Healing Down before capture.

concreteDecisions.why: Quarry setup identifies the hostile caster worth denying mana, trading an Aetherist damage release for prepared single-target resource disruption.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/5MP Mystic Power9 and MP Drain5 specialize against the prepared target.
concreteDecisions.counter: Remove Mark, break sight or rely on low-mana actions.

concreteDecisions.why: Both halves support choosing one or two prepared quarries for a costly direct Poison application, distinct from the Wildwarden persistent Ground field or a simple shot multiplier.
concreteDecisions.decision: 60AP/8MP gives each chosen quarry Physical Power9 and an actual15% Poison application based on settled HP loss. Mark is not consumed and no target is chosen automatically.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Mark before selection, close inside minimum range, spread outside sight/range or Barrier each seed hit; Poison uses the real captured trigger policy.

concreteDecisions.why: A marked hunt can open a brief Root-and-Covert disengage window, giving the hunter a concealed route choice instead of another source of damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP applies Rooted1 and grants Self Covert1 for an escape/setup decision.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Mark/Root, Sensory the owner or deny sight.

concreteDecisions.why: A prepared quarry can be pulled toward fist range, so the hunting half chooses the victim and the close-control half exploits actual traversed landing tiles.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/4MP Power9 and Pull2 bring a quarry near without occupying the caster tile.
concreteDecisions.counter: Remove Mark, Root or block the route.

concreteDecisions.why: Marked quarry attention and guarded ownership protect a chosen hunt or companion position; Taunt stays source-relative and never redirects damage automatically.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP Taunts that quarry and grants Guarded12%1 to Self; no companion damage redirection is invented.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Taunt/Mark, switch legal options or break sight.

concreteDecisions.why: A marked wounded quarry permits a dangerous HP-paid attrition shot, making preparation and target HP matter before the Ravager decides whether to finish or keep bleeding it.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/10HP Power12 seeds20% Bleed only when target is already at or below50%HP.
concreteDecisions.counter: Recover above half, remove Mark or Barrier the actual seed hit.

concreteDecisions.why: Wildwarden establishes a quarry while Edgedancer chooses a real route. The pair changes both positions without attacking: it can reel a ranged quarry toward the new melee angle or away from an ally. Flanking Cut only moves the owner one tile before damaging; Pursuit Shot instead leaves both positions intact. The sacrifice is all immediate attack pressure.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/4MP includes Move2 then Pull2 from the actual reached origin against a Marked enemy within1–3. It deals no damage, grants no Blindside, preserves Mark and never pulls onto the caster.
concreteDecisions.counter: Missing Mark, owner Rooted or an illegal route rejects atomically. A Rooted quarry resists displacement even after a legal paid route. Occupancy/landing can shorten Pull; no extra walking surcharge or overlapping destination is permitted.

concreteDecisions.why: A held whole-command commitment lets the player time explicit Dispel before a Mystic frontline hit, differing from both ordinary Physical pressure and a passive rune multiplier.
concreteDecisions.decision: Free once-per-battle prime holds the command; paid55AP/7MP release explicitly Dispels before Mystic Power14. No effect occurs on prime.
concreteDecisions.counter: Move out of adjacency, spend the protection before release or deny resources; invalid release retains prime and pays nothing.

concreteDecisions.why: Flat prevention bridges the wait for a captured next-round heal, so rune defense and healing urgency create a two-clock shelter rather than a larger immediate recovery number.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP gives15Barrier now and6%HP next round as separate captured resources.
concreteDecisions.counter: Burst through the shield before the scheduled heal or apply Healing Down at capture.

concreteDecisions.why: High reserves fund a single-donor copy-and-drain choice, letting the build borrow defense and deny mana while giving up immediate HP damage and retaining donor buffs.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/6MP copies eligible Buffs first, then drains enemy6MP; donor buffs remain because no Dispel is authored.
concreteDecisions.counter: Drain owner reserves, remove donor buffs or rely on low-MP actions; this does not transfer the drained mana.

concreteDecisions.why: Farstrider provides a distant source-owned mark and Runeblade turns that information into an explicit hostile mana inscription. Choosing the seal sacrifices the mark’s future aiming value and all direct damage to disrupt an imminent enemy payment/output. Aimed Shot and Aether Cut cannot change enemyMP or outgoing-damage state; Rune Guard instead repairs the owner.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP spends the enemy Mark on a connected Standard utility command: remove Mark first, drain4MP and apply Suppress25%1 at range2–5. It deals no damage and claims no future Armor benefit.
concreteDecisions.counter: Missing Mark rejects. A Standard miss spends the legal command cost but retains Mark and denies drain/Suppress. Cleanse Suppress before attacking or spendMP before the seal to reduce denial; sight/minimum range remain real.

concreteDecisions.why: A single donor is copied before an explicit Dispel and a short concealed window, so stealing language is replaced by a real ordered borrowing-and-denial decision.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/6MP copies Buffs first, explicitly Dispels the authored list, then grants Self Covert1.
concreteDecisions.counter: No eligible donor yields no copied buff; Sensory or area threats punish the escape.

concreteDecisions.why: Fist vulnerability prepares a short Mystic suppression strike, trading an existing opening for reduced retaliation instead of adding an unconditional damage scalar.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/5MP Mystic Power10 and Suppress20%1 exploit the setup to blunt retaliation.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Vulnerable before cast or Suppress afterward; DoT ticks retain captured values.

concreteDecisions.why: Split-recipient Barrier and a real Self stance let the defender choose which friendly body to shelter while accepting Fortified constraints and no damage redirection.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP grants ally18Barrier and Self Fortified1, a split-recipient commitment.
concreteDecisions.counter: Separate the pair or exploit the stance drawback; no transferred damage.

concreteDecisions.why: The owner can spend HP on a close Mystic mana-denial hit, making safety and defense-family choice compete with the Ravager straightforward Physical attrition tools.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP/15HP Mystic Power14 plus MP Drain4 spends safety to disrupt mana.
concreteDecisions.counter: Kite, use Mystic Defense or punish the payer; HP payment emits no damage event.

concreteDecisions.why: A modest moving hit invests in next-round Haste, making the build plan one current reached origin and one future route instead of buying generic movement damage.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/5MP includes Move1 and Power9 now, followed by Self Haste1 next global round. The current move does not receive the future status.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root or block the approach, then Dispel Haste after activation or force a stationary next turn.

concreteDecisions.why: A marked quarry becomes eligible for nondamaging recovery and mana denial, so the player decides between resource pressure now and a prepared damaging pursuit shot.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP applies Healing Down20%2 and MP Drain4 without dealing damage.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Mark before cast, break sight or use the actual negative-status counters.

concreteDecisions.why: A paid owner Vanguard attack can fund one finite Barrier reaction, preserving a direct offensive turn while giving up mana rather than receiving permanent passive protection.
concreteDecisions.decision: Once per owner turn, pay4MP for12Barrier after that owner attack; no free guard reaction to enemy casts.
concreteDecisions.counter: Drain MP or deny Vanguard attacks; flat protection cannot fund another attack.

concreteDecisions.why: Two individually low-HP friendly recipients can receive modest recovery and a short guard window, forcing triage selection rather than unconditional whole-party healing.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/7MP gives each7%HP and Guarded10%1; every selected unit must satisfy the threshold.
concreteDecisions.counter: Bring one recipient above threshold to make that selection illegal, or apply Healing Down.

concreteDecisions.why: Retained mana lets the caster shield a chosen friendly body while recovering a smaller independent amount of Self mana, making prevention a real reserve investment.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/6MP grants ally20Barrier and restores Self3MP; reserve checks precede payment.
concreteDecisions.counter: Drain reserves before cast or focus through the modest flat shield.

concreteDecisions.why: A wounded ranged guardian can establish a distant Mark while recovering modestly, sacrificing the shot now for a later accuracy lane and survivable firing posture.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP applies Mark12%2 and gives Self5%HP; this trades shot damage for preparation/sustain.
concreteDecisions.counter: Close range, remove Mark or apply Healing Down.

concreteDecisions.why: Control relief and a brief Invisible window enable a defensive reset, contrasting full Cleanse with concealment counters rather than pretending every negative effect is removed.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/5MP full-Cleanses Self and grants Invisible1; it does not grant Covert.
concreteDecisions.counter: Sensory/Reveal or area pressure counters Invisible; statuses outside Cleanse remain.

concreteDecisions.why: A wounded owner can full-Cleanse after a paid fist attack, choosing to fight through affliction while preserving the larger friendly Purge option for another turn.
concreteDecisions.decision: Once per owner turn after that qualifying owner attack, pay4MP to full-Cleanse Self. No removable affliction means no activation, payment or usage consumption; the canonical list also removes Suppress through the existing kernel policy.
concreteDecisions.counter: Deny close attacks, starve MP or use statuses outside the actual Cleanse behavior; other actors do not qualify.

concreteDecisions.why: A chosen friendly recipient receives real control relief and sustained guard, so the build protects a body or Self without inventing a damage-sharing link.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP full-Cleanses and grants that friendly recipient Guarded15%2.
concreteDecisions.counter: Separate allies, reapply control after cooldown or Dispel Guarded.

concreteDecisions.why: Reckless preparation enables explicit HP-paid rescue and Cleanse, making the payer safety and exact friendly recipient the combination defining choice instead of another attack leech.
concreteDecisions.decision: 45AP/5MP/20HP gives the selected friend10%HP and full Cleanse. Recovery is independently capped and modified; it is not a transfer equal to the payment.
concreteDecisions.counter: Punish the Reckless payer or apply Healing Down; costs leave1HP and never emit damage reactions. With Self selected the actual netHP includes both payment and capped recovery.

concreteDecisions.why: A short legal step can be taken with flat prevention instead of damage, linking duel route planning to an immediate shield budget rather than an automatic invulnerable dash.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP includes Move1 and18Barrier for a protective positioning action.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root, occupancy or burst exceeding18 counters the exit.

concreteDecisions.why: A real finite companion or another friendly body can receive Cleanse and Barrier, preserving its captured lifetime while choosing relief over an immediate hunt payoff.
concreteDecisions.decision: 40AP/5MP gives full Cleanse and15Barrier to that friendly recipient without rewriting summon lifetime.
concreteDecisions.counter: Separate or defeat the companion; Barrier cannot refresh its finite turns.

concreteDecisions.why: The caster pays HP for two selected preventive/cleansing recipients, binding rune protection and dawn relief to a real safety cost and bounded recipient decision.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/8MP/20HP grants each chosen friend20Barrier and full Cleanse. HP is a real payment that leaves1HP, not damage or a transfer equal to the shield.
concreteDecisions.counter: Pressure the payer, split friends out of range or reapply afflictions after cooldown; the flat shield does not scale with HP.

concreteDecisions.why: A single legal approach changes frontline access to Fire pressure, making the owner choose Mystic contact and actual caster Chilled removal rather than free walking plus a sword bonus.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP includes Move1 and Fire Power11 with actor-only Chilled cleanse; no free Burn is inferred.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root the approach, Barrier the hit or use Mystic Defense.

concreteDecisions.why: Fixed urgent relief is paired with full affliction removal, offering a small affordable alternative to percentage triage while fire pressure remains the opposite turn choice.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/4MP gives full Cleanse and flat20HP; fixed recovery has no hidden Power or max-HP scaling.
concreteDecisions.counter: Healing Down reduces the fixed recovery, and incoming burst can overwhelm20HP.

concreteDecisions.why: HP can be invested in future maximum-MP recovery under a narrow Burn Ward window, so the caster must survive a resource gap instead of passively amplifying damage while rich.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/20HP grants Burn Ward1 now and one captured8% maximumMP recovery next round; it creates no HP damage event or immediate mana refund.
concreteDecisions.counter: Burst before the resource arrives, deny low-mana eligibility or force defense; finite cooldown and AP/HP payments prevent a no-input loop.

concreteDecisions.why: A distant Fire sighting sets current Mark for later precision, combining real fire intent and source-scoped accuracy setup without inventing elemental arrow conversion.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/6MP Fire Power9 and current Mark10%1 establish a long lane; Fire explicitly cleanses caster Chilled.
concreteDecisions.counter: Close minimum range, remove Mark or deny sight.

concreteDecisions.why: A Fire strike remains useful without afflictions, while real owner Burn opens an optional debuff-copy and concealment escape; donor Burn remains a real risk.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/6MP copies eligible Debuffs first, then Fire Power7. If the owner was already Burning, Self also gains Covert1; owner Burn remains. Without eligible donor afflictions the copy block may be empty and the Fire action still matters.
concreteDecisions.counter: Deny the single target, Barrier the hit or Reveal after optional Covert. Owner Burning is a risk window, not a prerequisite for the whole pair action.

concreteDecisions.why: Fire at contact is paired with a real Push route, letting the build create space while caster Chilled removal and elemental counterplay stay explicit.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/5MP Fire Power10 and Push1 clear close space; caster Chilled removal is explicit.
concreteDecisions.counter: Root or occupancy blocks the push, and Barrier limits damage.

concreteDecisions.why: Heat setup supports a source-relative challenge now and flat prevention next round, requiring the defender to survive the intervening timing window rather than gain instant concealment.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/5MP Taunts that prepared enemy1 now and schedules Self20Barrier next round. Burn remains; the challenge does not force an invented enemy action.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Burn before cast or Taunt afterward, pressure before the delayed shield or switch legal targets.

concreteDecisions.why: Vulnerability and HP payment commit a fire bruiser to actual Burning attrition, forcing a safety decision before the seed damage rather than a free element multiplier.
concreteDecisions.decision: 55AP/6MP/15HP yields Fire Power13 and20% decaying Burn, with explicit Chilled cleanse.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Vulnerable before cast, Barrier the seed hit or punish the HP payer.

concreteDecisions.why: Existing Burn opens an explicit Dispel plus future Haste turn, letting the duelist trade present damage for stripping protection and preparing a later route.
concreteDecisions.decision: 35AP/5MP explicitly Dispels the enemy positive list and grants Self Haste1 next round. Burn remains and no Fire packet or conversion is invented.
concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Burn before cast, avoid valuable buffs or pressure the owner before the next-round movement benefit.

concreteDecisions.why: Wildwarden’s marked poisoned quarry becomes an actual spend decision for Cinderweaver: trade away future Poison attrition to buy a Fire hit and immediate movement denial in one command. Cinder Bolt preserves Poison and adds Burn but cannot Root; Ember Line keeps formation damage. Rooting a quarry does not create entry damage while it stands still. The kit’s native Poison Ground remains provisional for its canonical bridge.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/6MP requires prior Mark and Poison; a connected command removes Poison, strikes with Fire Power12 and applies Rooted1. Mark remains. It adds no Burn; the explicit Fire caster Chilled cleanse remains.
concreteDecisions.counter: Removing either prior Mark or Poison rejects without payment. A Standard miss leaves Poison intact and applies no Rooted; connected fullBarrier can still spend Poison and Root. Cleanse Rooted or use a ranged response; no extra Ground tick is invented for standing still.

concreteDecisions.why: A single donor can be copied before Fire pressure, creating ordered borrowing without Dispel while rune reserves fund a choice between utility and heat.
concreteDecisions.decision: 50AP/6MP copies eligible Buffs first then Fire Power9; donor buffs remain because no Dispel is authored.
concreteDecisions.counter: Remove donor buffs first, deny sight or use Barrier; Fire does not imply theft.

concreteDecisions.counter: Drain reserves before cast or break sight; the conditional refund is smaller than its MP payment.

concreteDecisions.counter: Remove Mark to block cast or Root to deny bonus; Barrier and minimum range remain counters.

concreteDecisions.why: A prior Chilled target permits ordered Debuff copying before a physical pressure packet, giving an afflicted concealed fighter a specific prepared donor/recipient decision.

concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Chilled before cast, remove copied negatives after or deny adjacency.

concreteDecisions.counter: Cleanse Chilled before commitment, block/Root the Pull route or cleanse Root afterward; an adjacent target is outside this action minimum range.

concreteDecisions.counter: Face/evade the strike, Cleanse Chilled or Barrier the Bleed seed.

concreteDecisions.why: A bounded advance establishes Chilled at a reached origin, letting the duelist trade raw melee output for a facing-control setup without creating Frozen Ground.

concreteDecisions.counter: Root, occupancy or Barrier deny access/setup; Frozen Ground is not created.

concreteDecisions.counter: Deny the donor, reapply elemental setup or Dispel copied benefits.
